concept.title: Help with household tasks
concept.shortdesc: Practical help with everyday domestic jobs such as cleaning, light housework, errands, cooking and tidying or decluttering the home.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
